math_steps.explanation: $$\begin{gathered}-2b+\left(b+1\right)=0\\b=1\\\text{定义域为 }\left[-2, 2\right]\\\text{单调区间为 }\left[-2, 0\right]\\\text{偶函数 }f(u)=f(-u)=f(|u|)\\f(x-1)\le f(2x)\Leftrightarrow f(\left|x - 1\right|)\le f(\left|2 x\right|)\end{gathered}$$

highlight.caption: 先确定定义域中的参数，再把两个输入都变成非负数

math_steps.explanation: $$\begin{gathered}f\text{ 在 }\left[-2, 0\right]\text{ 上严格递增}\\\text{偶函数在对称两侧单调方向相反}\Rightarrow f\text{ 在 }\left[0, 2\right]\text{ 上严格递减}\end{gathered}$$

math_steps.explanation: $$\begin{gathered}f\text{ 在 }\left[0, 2\right]\text{ 上严格递减}\text{，不等号方向改变}\\f(\left|x - 1\right|)\le f(\left|2 x\right|)\Leftrightarrow \left|x - 1\right|\ge \left|2 x\right|\end{gathered}$$

highlight.caption: 去掉函数符号比较输入

items.label: 已知条件
items.math: \begin{gathered}f\text{ 在 }\left[0, 2\right]\text{ 上严格递减}\\f(\left|x - 1\right|)\le f(\left|2 x\right|)\end{gathered}

math_steps.title: 去掉函数符号比较输入

math_steps.explanation: $$\begin{gathered}x-1\in \left[-2, 2\right]\\2\cdot x\in \left[-2, 2\right]\\\Rightarrow -1\le x\le 1\\\left|x - 1\right|\ge \left|2 x\right|\Leftrightarrow \left(x - 1\right)^2\ge \left(2 x\right)^2\\\Leftrightarrow - 3 x^{2} - 2 x + 1\ge 0\Rightarrow -1\le x\le \frac{1}{3}\\\text{求交得 }-1\le x\le \frac{1}{3}\end{gathered}$$
